WriteError.doc: Write-side failure. Causes: (a) row does not fit in the remaining page free space (page-full — deferred split path); (b) unsupported Value payload (blob in this probe); (c) I/O failure bubbling up from the file-write syscall.

WriteOk.doc: Successful write: the new DbHeader.change_counter, the rowid assigned to the inserted row, the total bytes written (== file size after write), and a `did_split` flag indicating whether a leaf-page split fired during this insert. did_split=true also implies database_size grew (1 new page for non-root leaf split, 2 new pages for root-split).

insert_row.doc: Append a single row to a mainline-SQLite `.db` file backing a single-page table. Reads the file, decodes DbHeader + PageHeader + existing cells, appends one cell with the given Values encoded per SQLite's record format (serial-type varint sequence + payload), rewrites the page with an updated cell pointer array, bumps DbHeader.change_counter, and writes the file back atomically (rename-from-temp). Probe scope — single-table, single-page, rowid auto-assigned as max(existing)+1 (or 1 if empty). See master.md.
